mobbin:fa27d48b-3a4d-4764-b661-6e6ec0137.summary: From empty Who's on-call with drag hint, admin opens Configure rotations, schedules people via a people+time modal with Override other on-calls, sees the event on the month calendar, then configures Pre-fill rotations (roster, length, start) for two years.
steps: Empty Who's on-call — nobody on-call + drag hint
Configure rotations — month calendar + draggable people
Schedule on-call modal — one member + Override
Schedule on-call modal — two members + Override
Pre-fill rotations — roster, length Day, start, 2 years
steal: Empty-state instruction: drag team members into schedule (step 1).
Simple create: simultaneous members + start/end + Override other on-calls (steps 3–4).
People list with color + drag handles beside month/week calendar (steps 2, 5).
Pre-fill: ordered roster, rotation length unit, start datetime, next two years, Remove all future (step 6).
avoid: Blind Override other on-calls without showing who is displaced (steps 3–4) — sim rooms need explicit conflict resolution.
mobbin:fa27d48b-3a4d-4764-b661-6e6ec0137.fit: Cheapest rotation pre-fill for N sessions from a roster; map members→learners/faculty, length→session block; keep Override as opt-in conflict policy only.
